module_summary: Timer control FSM: detects serial pattern 1101, asserts shift_ena four cycles, counts until done_counting, then holds done until ack.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Ten-state controller: pattern search, B0-B3 shift, Count, Wait; decodes all outputs.

anchors.name: shift_ena
anchors.why: Tells external datapath to shift in delay bits during B0-B3.

anchors.name: done_counting
anchors.why: External counter expiry; moves FSM from Count to Wait.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Timeout notification held in Wait until ack.

anchors.name: ack
anchors.why: User acknowledge returning FSM to pattern search.

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: Serial input scanned for the 1101 start pattern.

groups.name: timer_fsm
groups.description: Next-state logic, state register and output decode for timer sequencing.
